Interface CreatedSlotResolver

All Known Implementing Classes:
CreatedSlotAdapter
public interface CreatedSlotResolver
Port (MK defines, MKC implements): resolve a CREATED_SLOT Address to its live in-menu slot.

Why a port (the §0042 reason)

A created slot is an MKCSlot — an MKC type MK must never reference — and only MKC can recognise one in menu.slots. MKC registers an implementation (a session-cached identity binding); when MKC is absent the resolver is null and created-slot resolution simply yields empty (created slots need MKC) — vanilla, panel, and element resolution stay fully MK-alone.

Position is not part of the port

A created slot's on-screen position is vanilla's own Slot.x/y on the in-menu slot, written each frame by the panel that presents it — exactly where a vanilla slot's position lives. So MK reads position off the returned Slot the same way for both kinds, and the port carries nothing but the slot. (Position used to be parked on the MKC type as renderX/renderY, which is why an earlier version of this port returned it; that made created slots invisible to vanilla's slot pass and to every other mod's slot hooks.)
